the application of metabolite level data to the study of yeast biology, and the integration of this data with other functional genomics approaches.
the development of novel tools and methods that will allow for high-throughput analysis of metabolic states in yeast and other model organisms.
the integration of high-throughput metabolic state data into yeast functional genomics.
